tested_condition: Reusable components are available to support later page materialization without replacing Phase 1 placeholders.
expected_outcome: The application exposes shared shell, intro, evidence, card, and CTA primitives that reflect authority patterns while keeping route placeholders intact.
actual_outcome: Existing placeholders were upgraded to consume reusable shell, intro, evidence, card, and CTA primitives while route files remained unchanged and still defer final content materialization.
passes: Reusable primitives now support page framing, intro rhythm, status sidecars, card grids, and CTA treatment.
Shared navigation and footer patterns were refined in the site shell instead of route-level implementations.
Placeholder routes continue to compile against shared primitives rather than bespoke page markup.

component_purpose_map.PageShell: Container primitive for consistent inner page width and vertical rhythm.
component_purpose_map.PageIntro: Reusable hero-intro structure with kicker, display title, lede, body, and optional aside.
component_purpose_map.EvidenceBlock: Status or evidence sidecar card using authority-derived surface, label, and value treatment.
component_purpose_map.CTABlock: Reusable CTA band with primary and secondary button-link variants.
component_purpose_map.SignalCard: Reusable editorial card for system-level content bands.
component_purpose_map.SiteShell: Global shell that carries the design-system header, note band, and footer.

phase3_page_materialization_support: Page intros can be reused for the approved narrative sequence without rewriting route scaffolds now.
Card grid and CTA patterns are ready for capability, exploration, and services sections in later phases.
Site shell reflects approved navigation/footer tone without final per-page content composition.
html_css_patterns_reflected: Sticky translucent header and muted nav links
Large editorial hero titles and constrained lede widths
Quiet content band and bordered CTA surface treatment
Subtle cards with light surfaces and soft shadows
